title: Evaluate local-density character sums modulo eight

source.citation: Cameron Wilson, Asymptotics for Local Solubility of Diagonal Quadrics Over a Split Quadric Surface, arXiv:2404.11489

translation.notes: Appendix B's 256 unit tuples modulo eight are enumerated exactly. The two displayed congruence sets and their signed Jacobi-character sums are evaluated, including all six stated coordinate permutations.
